datasheet.title: Zero-Volt Universal Reference & Earth Ground Plane
datasheet.package: Direct Chassis / Earth Terminal / PCB Star Ground Plane
datasheet.description: Universal 0.000V electrical datum defined by IEEE Green Book standards. Serves as nodal reference for all nodal matrix equations (Node 0) and low-impedance fault return.

pinout.name: GND Datum (0V)
pinout.desc: Single-point reference node for circuit potentials

datasheet.appNotes: Always connect at least one ground node in any circuit loop to fix the nodal matrix reference (V_0 = 0V) and prevent floating subnets.
